eventDetail.scope: DSIIP 2027 will be a high-level interdisciplinary academic forum focusing on two core research domains: data science and intelligent information processing. In the field of data science, the conference will focus on advanced big data mining, visual data analysis, and data-driven decision support systems, as well as wearable intelligent sensing and multimodal data fusion technologies for accurate perception of human behavior and environmental states. In terms of intelligent information processing, it will cover pattern recognition, computer vision understanding, natural language processing, audio signal processing, soft computing, fuzzy information processing, multi-agent collaborative systems, and human-machine interactive information processing technologies. Through professional interdisciplinary academic exchanges, DSIIP 2027 will promote theoretical progress and practical engineering applications in the fields of data science and intelligent information processing.
